issue.title: Make proxy connect timeout configurable for Rest Clients
issue.body:
### Description

In https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/issues/5634, @Adelrisk reported an issue regarding Rest Client and proxy configuration.

Netty uses a 10 seconds proxy connection timeout by default, that was not configurable in Vert.x before 4.5.17 (see https://github.com/eclipse-vertx/vert.x/pull/5655)

Now that this version is available to Quarkus, we could expose the new configuration property.



### Implementation ideas

Implementation involves a couple of Quarkus specific config classes, but I think a modification of `jakarta.ws.rs.client.ClientBuilder` is required too.

issue.title: Add support for the Proxy connect timeout in Quarkus REST Client
